views.name: v_artist_metric_latest
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.artist_id, m.platform, m.metric) m.company_id,
    m.artist_id,
    a.name AS artist_name,
    m.platform,
    m.metric,
    m.metric_date,
    m.value,
    m.source
   FROM (artist_metrics_daily m
     JOIN artists a ON ((a.id = m.artist_id)))
  ORDER BY m.artist_id, m.platform, m.metric, m.metric_date DESC,
        CASE m.source
            WHEN 'aggregator'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'platform_api'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'public_page'::text THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END, m.captured_at DESC NULLS LAST;

views.name: user_companies
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id,
    ur.company_id,
    c.display_name,
    c.slug,
    c.logo_url,
    c.status,
    ( SELECT ur2.role
           FROM user_roles ur2
          WHERE ((ur2.user_id = ur.user_id) AND (ur2.company_id = ur.company_id))
          ORDER BY
                CASE (ur2.role)::text
                    WHEN 'platform_admin'::text THEN 0
                    WHEN 'admin'::text THEN 1
                    WHEN 'manager'::text THEN 2
                    WHEN 'editor'::text THEN 3
                    WHEN 'partner'::text THEN 4
                    WHEN 'viewer'::text THEN 5
                    WHEN 'marketing_manager'::text THEN 5
                    WHEN 'user'::text THEN 6
                    ELSE 99
                END
         LIMIT 1) AS primary_role
   FROM (user_roles ur
     JOIN companies c ON ((c.id = ur.company_id)))
  WHERE ((ur.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (c.status = 'active'::text));

    count(DISTINCT l.event_id) AS eventos_afetados,

    max(l.created_at) AS ultimo
   FROM (tickets_v2_sync_log l
     JOIN companies c ON ((c.id = l.company_id)))

  GROUP BY c.display_name, l.trigger_action, l.operation

views.name: crm_contactos
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS contact_id,
    c.company_id,
    c.name,
    c.email,
    c.phone_e164,
    c.consent_email,
    c.consent_email_at,
    c.consent_whatsapp,
    c.consent_whatsapp_at,
    c.is_active,
    c.source,
    COALESCE(l.first_at, c.first_seen_at) AS first_contact_at,
    COALESCE(l.last_at, c.last_activity_at) AS last_contact_at,
    COALESCE(l.interactions, (0)::bigint) AS interactions,
    l.last_event_id,
    l.last_kind,
    c.created_at,
    c.updated_at,
    c.consent_whatsapp_source
   FROM (contacts c
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.contact_id,
            min(x.created_at) AS first_at,
            max(x.created_at) AS last_at,
            count(*) AS interactions,
            (array_agg(x.event_id ORDER BY x.created_at DESC))[1] AS last_event_id,
            (array_agg(x.kind ORDER BY x.created_at DESC))[1] AS last_kind
           FROM leads x
          WHERE ((x.kind = ANY (ARRAY['event_interest'::text, 'newsletter_signup'::text])) AND (x.contact_id IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY x.contact_id) l ON ((l.contact_id = c.id)))
  WHERE ((c.email IS NOT NULL) OR (c.phone_e164 IS NOT NULL));

views.name: v_artist_comparables
views.definition:
SELECT c.id,
    c.company_id,
    c.artist_id,
    a.name AS artist_name,
    a.slug AS artist_slug,
    c.comparable_artist_id,
    b.name AS comparable_name,
    b.slug AS comparable_slug,
    b.photo_url AS comparable_photo_url,
    b.roster_type AS comparable_roster_type,
    c."position",
    c.reason,
    c.chosen_by,
    c.created_at,
    cs.value AS comparable_spotify_monthly_listeners,
    ci.value AS comparable_instagram_followers,
    ct.value AS comparable_tiktok_followers,
    cy.value AS comparable_youtube_subscribers,
    as_.value AS artist_spotify_monthly_listeners,
    ai.value AS artist_instagram_followers,
    at_.value AS artist_tiktok_followers,
    ay.value AS artist_youtube_subscribers
   FROM ((((((((((artist_comparables c
     JOIN artists a ON ((a.id = c.artist_id)))
     JOIN artists b ON ((b.id = c.comparable_artist_id)))
     LEFT JOIN v_artist_metric_latest cs ON (((cs.artist_id = c.comparable_artist_id) AND (cs.platform = 'spotify'::text) AND (cs.metric = 'monthly_listeners'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN v_artist_metric_latest ci ON (((ci.artist_id = c.comparable_artist_id) AND (ci.platform = 'instagram'::text) AND (ci.metric = 'followers'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN v_artist_metric_latest ct ON (((ct.artist_id = c.comparable_artist_id) AND (ct.platform = 'tiktok'::text) AND (ct.metric = 'followers'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN v_artist_metric_latest cy ON (((cy.artist_id = c.comparable_artist_id) AND (cy.platform = 'youtube'::text) AND (cy.metric = 'subscribers'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN v_artist_metric_latest as_ ON (((as_.artist_id = c.artist_id) AND (as_.platform = 'spotify'::text) AND (as_.metric = 'monthly_listeners'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN v_artist_metric_latest ai ON (((ai.artist_id = c.artist_id) AND (ai.platform = 'instagram'::text) AND (ai.metric = 'followers'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN v_artist_metric_latest at_ ON (((at_.artist_id = c.artist_id) AND (at_.platform = 'tiktok'::text) AND (at_.metric = 'followers'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN v_artist_metric_latest ay ON (((ay.artist_id = c.artist_id) AND (ay.platform = 'youtube'::text) AND (ay.metric = 'subscribers'::text))));

views.name: extensions.pg_stat_statements_info
v_song_link_blitz_geo
views.definition:
SELECT e.id,
    e.created_at,
    e.event,
    e.utm_campaign,
    e.country,
    e.region,
    e.city,
    t.prefix,
    t.target_city,
    t.target_state,
    c.lat AS city_lat,
    c.lon AS city_lon,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.lat IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(((((2 * 6371))::double precision * asin(sqrt((power(sin(radians((((c.lat - t.target_lat) / (2)::numeric))::double precision)), (2)::double precision) + ((cos(radians((t.target_lat)::double precision)) * cos(radians((c.lat)::double precision))) * power(sin(radians((((c.lon - t.target_lon) / (2)::numeric))::double precision)), (2)::double precision)))))))::numeric, 1)
        END AS dist_km_alvo
   FROM ((song_link_events e
     JOIN v_song_link_blitz_targets t ON ((lower(e.utm_campaign) ~~ (t.prefix || '%'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN ip_city_centroids() c(country, region, city, lat, lon) ON (((c.country = e.country) AND (NOT (c.region IS DISTINCT FROM e.region)) AND (c.city = e.city))))
  WHERE (e.utm_campaign ~~* 'blitz\_%'::text);

    e.description_pt,

    e.poster_image_url,
    e.venue_map_url,
    e.venue_directions_url,
    e.ticketing_url,
    e.meta_pixel_id,
    ep.featured,

    em.description_long_en,
    em.meta_description_pt,
    em.meta_description_en,
    em.og_image_url,
    em.poster_vertical_url,
    em.gallery_urls,
    em.press_quote_pt,
    em.press_quote_en,
    em.press_quote_source,
    em.cta_primary_label_pt,
    em.cta_primary_label_en,
    em.urgency_message_pt,
    em.urgency_message_en,
    em.performer_name,
    em.performer_url,
    em.offer_price_min,
    em.offer_price_max,
    em.offer_currency,
    em.offer_availability,
    (em.event_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_marketing,
    ep.portal_company_id,
    ep.partner_label AS endorsement_partner_label,
    ep.display_order AS endorsement_display_order,
    true AS is_endorsement,
    em.hero_video_url,
    em.music_embed_url,
    em.ticket_experiences,
    e.vip_coupon_code,
    e.vip_coupon_discount_label,
    e.vip_coupon_valid_until,
    e.parent_event_id,
    e.event_type,
    e.city_id,
    c.name AS city_name,
    em.age_rating,
    COALESCE(em.ticket_lots, '[]'::jsonb) AS ticket_lots,
    em.doors_time,
    e.title_es,
    e.description_es,
    e.location_es,
    em.hook_es,
    em.description_long_es,
    em.meta_description_es,
    em.cta_primary_label_es,
    em.urgency_message_es
   FROM (((event_portal_endorsements ep
     JOIN events e ON ((e.id = ep.event_id)))
     LEFT JOIN event_marketing em ON (((em.event_id = e.id) AND (em.status = 'published'::text))))

views.name: v_artist_release_performance
views.definition:
WITH agg AS (
         SELECT rm.company_id,
            rm.artist_id,
            rm.release_id,
            rm.platform,
            rm.metric,
            min(rm.metric_date) AS first_date,
            max(rm.metric_date) AS latest_date
           FROM artist_release_metrics_daily rm
          GROUP BY rm.company_id, rm.artist_id, rm.release_id, rm.platform, rm.metric
        )
 SELECT g.company_id,
    g.artist_id,
    a.name AS artist_name,
    g.release_id,
    r.title,
    g.platform,
    r.published_at,
    (r.published_at)::date AS release_date,
    g.metric,
    g.first_date,
    fv.value AS first_value,
    g.latest_date,
    lv.value AS latest_value,
    p7.value AS d7_value,
    p30.value AS d30_value,
    (lv.value - fv.value) AS total_gain,
    (g.latest_date - g.first_date) AS days_tracked,
    round(((lv.value - fv.value) / (NULLIF((g.latest_date - g.first_date), 0))::numeric), 2) AS avg_daily_gain,
    (g.first_date - (r.published_at)::date) AS tracking_started_days_after_release
   FROM ((((((agg g
     JOIN artist_releases r ON ((r.id = g.release_id)))
     JOIN artists a ON ((a.id = g.artist_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.value
           FROM artist_release_metrics_daily s
          WHERE ((s.release_id = g.release_id) AND (s.platform = g.platform) AND (s.metric = g.metric) AND (s.metric_date = g.first_date))
          ORDER BY s.captured_at DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) fv ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.value
           FROM artist_release_metrics_daily s
          WHERE ((s.release_id = g.release_id) AND (s.platform = g.platform) AND (s.metric = g.metric) AND (s.metric_date = g.latest_date))
          ORDER BY s.captured_at DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) lv ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.value
           FROM artist_release_metrics_daily s
          WHERE ((s.release_id = g.release_id) AND (s.platform = g.platform) AND (s.metric = g.metric) AND ((s.metric_date >= ((r.published_at)::date + 4)) AND (s.metric_date <= ((r.published_at)::date + 10))))
          ORDER BY (abs((s.metric_date - ((r.published_at)::date + 7))))
         LIMIT 1) p7 ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.value
           FROM artist_release_metrics_daily s
          WHERE ((s.release_id = g.release_id) AND (s.platform = g.platform) AND (s.metric = g.metric) AND ((s.metric_date >= ((r.published_at)::date + 27)) AND (s.metric_date <= ((r.published_at)::date + 33))))
          ORDER BY (abs((s.metric_date - ((r.published_at)::date + 30))))
         LIMIT 1) p30 ON (true));

views.name: v_content_growth
views.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT artist_content_metrics_daily.content_id,
            artist_content_metrics_daily.company_id,
            artist_content_metrics_daily.artist_id,
            artist_content_metrics_daily.platform,
            artist_content_metrics_daily.metric,
            artist_content_metrics_daily.metric_date,
            artist_content_metrics_daily.value
           FROM artist_content_metrics_daily
          WHERE (artist_content_metrics_daily.metric = ANY (ARRAY['views'::text, 'likes'::text]))
        ), last_pt AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (base.content_id, base.metric) base.content_id,
            base.company_id,
            base.artist_id,
            base.platform,
            base.metric,
            base.metric_date,
            base.value
           FROM base
          ORDER BY base.content_id, base.metric, base.metric_date DESC
        )
 SELECT content_id,
    company_id,
    artist_id,
    platform,
    metric,
    metric_date AS last_metric_date,
    value AS value_latest,
    (value - ( SELECT b.value
           FROM base b
          WHERE ((b.content_id = l.content_id) AND (b.metric = l.metric) AND (b.metric_date <= (l.metric_date - 1)))
          ORDER BY b.metric_date DESC
         LIMIT 1)) AS delta_1d,
    (value - ( SELECT b.value
           FROM base b
          WHERE ((b.content_id = l.content_id) AND (b.metric = l.metric) AND (b.metric_date <= (l.metric_date - 7)))
          ORDER BY b.metric_date DESC
         LIMIT 1)) AS delta_7d,
    (value - ( SELECT b.value
           FROM base b
          WHERE ((b.content_id = l.content_id) AND (b.metric = l.metric) AND (b.metric_date <= (l.metric_date - 30)))
          ORDER BY b.metric_date DESC
         LIMIT 1)) AS delta_30d
   FROM last_pt l;

views.name: v_artist_audience_by_state
views.definition:
WITH base AS (

            d.timeframe,
            d.snapshot_date,
            d.value,
            regexp_replace(btrim(SUBSTRING(d.dim_key FROM (POSITION((', '::text) IN (d.dim_key)) + 2))), '\s*\(state\)$'::text, ''::text) AS estado_nome
           FROM artist_audience_demographics d
          WHERE ((d.dimension = 'city'::text) AND (POSITION((', '::text) IN (d.dim_key)) > 0) AND (d.song_id IS NULL))
        )
 SELECT b.company_id,
    b.artist_id,

    b.timeframe,
    b.snapshot_date,
    e.uf,
    COALESCE(e.regiao, 'Fora do Brasil'::text) AS regiao,
    b.estado_nome,
    sum(b.value) AS valor,
    round(((100.0 * sum(b.value)) / NULLIF(sum(sum(b.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY b.artist_id, b.platform, b.audience_type, b.snapshot_date), (0)::numeric)), 1) AS quota_pct
   FROM (base b
     LEFT JOIN br_estados e ON ((e.nome = b.estado_nome)))
  GROUP BY b.company_id, b.artist_id, b.platform, b.audience_type, b.timeframe, b.snapshot_date, e.uf, e.regiao, b.estado_nome;

views.name: vw_sync_health
views.definition:
WITH coala_last AS (
         SELECT r.id,
            r.config_id,
            r.event_id,
            r.company_id,
            r.mode,
            r.triggered_by,
            r.status,
            r.xlsx_sha256,
            r.xlsx_size_bytes,
            r.file_version,
            r.total_rows,
            r.new_count,
            r.updated_count,
            r.removed_count,
            r.conflict_count,
            r.diff,
            r.error_message,
            r.started_at,
            r.finished_at,
            r.triggered_user_id
           FROM (coala_sync_runs r
             JOIN ( SELECT coala_sync_runs.config_id,
                    max(coala_sync_runs.started_at) AS m
                   FROM coala_sync_runs
                  GROUP BY coala_sync_runs.config_id) x ON (((x.config_id = r.config_id) AND (x.m = r.started_at))))
        ), coala_agg AS (
         SELECT 'Coala (Google Drive)'::text AS sync_name,
            max(coala_sync_runs.started_at) AS last_run_at,
            ( SELECT coala_last.status
                   FROM coala_last
                  ORDER BY coala_last.started_at DESC
                 LIMIT 1) AS last_run_status,
            NULLIF((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (max(coala_sync_runs.finished_at) - max(coala_sync_runs.started_at))))::integer, 0) AS last_run_duration_sec,
            (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - max(coala_sync_runs.started_at))))::integer AS seconds_since_last_run,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((coala_sync_runs.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AND (coala_sync_runs.status = ANY (ARRAY['failed'::text, 'blocked'::text, 'needs_review'::text, 'partial_failed'::text, 'classify_failed'::text, 'download_failed'::text, 'parse_failed'::text, 'import_failed'::text])))) AS runs_needing_action_24h,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((coala_sync_runs.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AND (coala_sync_runs.status = 'success'::text))) AS runs_success_24h,
            1 AS expected_runs_24h,
            86400 AS expected_interval_sec
           FROM coala_sync_runs
        ), fever_runs_agg AS (
         SELECT 'Fever (Reports)'::text AS sync_name,
            max(fever_sync_runs.started_at) AS last_run_at,
            ( SELECT fever_sync_runs_1.status
                   FROM fever_sync_runs fever_sync_runs_1
                  ORDER BY fever_sync_runs_1.started_at DESC
                 LIMIT 1) AS last_run_status,
            NULLIF((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (max(fever_sync_runs.finished_at) - max(fever_sync_runs.started_at))))::integer, 0) AS last_run_duration_sec,
            (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - max(fever_sync_runs.started_at))))::integer AS seconds_since_last_run,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((fever_sync_runs.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AND (fever_sync_runs.status = ANY (ARRAY['failed'::text, 'blocked'::text, 'needs_review'::text])))) AS runs_needing_action_24h,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((fever_sync_runs.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AND (fever_sync_runs.status = 'success'::text))) AS runs_success_24h,
            1 AS expected_runs_24h,
            86400 AS expected_interval_sec
           FROM fever_sync_runs
        ), fever_token_agg AS (
         SELECT 'Fever (Token Refresh)'::text AS sync_name,
            max(fever_sync_config.last_token_refresh_at) AS last_run_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN (max(fever_sync_config.last_token_refresh_at) IS NULL) THEN 'never'::text
                    ELSE 'success'::text
                END AS last_run_status,
            NULL::integer AS last_run_duration_sec,
            (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - max(fever_sync_config.last_token_refresh_at))))::integer AS seconds_since_last_run,
            (0)::bigint AS runs_needing_action_24h,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (fever_sync_config.last_token_refresh_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS runs_success_24h,
            2 AS expected_runs_24h,
            43200 AS expected_interval_sec
           FROM fever_sync_config
          WHERE (fever_sync_config.enabled = true)
        ), all_syncs AS (
         SELECT coala_agg.sync_name,
            coala_agg.last_run_at,
            coala_agg.last_run_status,
            coala_agg.last_run_duration_sec,
            coala_agg.seconds_since_last_run,
            coala_agg.runs_needing_action_24h,
            coala_agg.runs_success_24h,
            coala_agg.expected_runs_24h,
            coala_agg.expected_interval_sec
           FROM coala_agg
        UNION ALL
         SELECT fever_runs_agg.sync_name,
            fever_runs_agg.last_run_at,
            fever_runs_agg.last_run_status,
            fever_runs_agg.last_run_duration_sec,
            fever_runs_agg.seconds_since_last_run,
            fever_runs_agg.runs_needing_action_24h,
            fever_runs_agg.runs_success_24h,
            fever_runs_agg.expected_runs_24h,
            fever_runs_agg.expected_interval_sec
           FROM fever_runs_agg
        UNION ALL
         SELECT fever_token_agg.sync_name,
            fever_token_agg.last_run_at,
            fever_token_agg.last_run_status,
            fever_token_agg.last_run_duration_sec,
            fever_token_agg.seconds_since_last_run,
            fever_token_agg.runs_needing_action_24h,
            fever_token_agg.runs_success_24h,
            fever_token_agg.expected_runs_24h,
            fever_token_agg.expected_interval_sec
           FROM fever_token_agg
        )
 SELECT sync_name,
    last_run_at,
    last_run_status,
    last_run_duration_sec,
    seconds_since_last_run,
    (runs_needing_action_24h)::integer AS runs_needing_action_24h,
    (runs_success_24h)::integer AS runs_success_24h,
    expected_runs_24h,
    ((seconds_since_last_run IS NOT NULL) AND (seconds_since_last_run > (((expected_interval_sec)::numeric * 1.5))::integer)) AS is_stale,
        CASE
            WHEN (last_run_status = ANY (ARRAY['failed'::text, 'blocked'::text, 'partial_failed'::text, 'classify_failed'::text, 'download_failed'::text, 'parse_failed'::text, 'import_failed'::text])) THEN 'critical'::text
            WHEN (last_run_status = 'needs_review'::text) THEN 'warning'::text
            WHEN (runs_needing_action_24h > 0) THEN 'warning'::text
            WHEN ((seconds_since_last_run IS NOT NULL) AND (seconds_since_last_run > (((expected_interval_sec)::numeric * 1.5))::integer)) THEN 'warning'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS health
   FROM all_syncs;

views.name: v_sync_health
views.definition:
WITH last_run AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (sync_runs.function_name) sync_runs.function_name,
            sync_runs.status,
            sync_runs.started_at,
            sync_runs.finished_at,
            sync_runs.duration_ms,
            sync_runs.api_calls,
            sync_runs.rows_written,
            sync_runs.dry_run
           FROM sync_runs
          ORDER BY sync_runs.function_name, sync_runs.started_at DESC
        ), month_calls AS (
         SELECT sync_runs.function_name,
            sum(sync_runs.api_calls) AS api_calls_month
           FROM sync_runs
          WHERE (sync_runs.started_at >= date_trunc('month'::text, now()))
          GROUP BY sync_runs.function_name
        )
 SELECT l.function_name,
    l.status AS last_status,
    l.started_at AS last_started_at,
    l.finished_at AS last_finished_at,
    l.duration_ms AS last_duration_ms,
    l.api_calls AS last_api_calls,
    l.rows_written AS last_rows_written,
    l.dry_run AS last_dry_run,
    COALESCE(m.api_calls_month, (0)::bigint) AS api_calls_month
   FROM (last_run l
     LEFT JOIN month_calls m ON ((m.function_name = l.function_name)));

views.name: v_song_growth
views.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.song_id, m.platform, m.metric) m.company_id,
            m.song_id,
            m.artist_id,
            m.platform,
            m.metric,
            m.metric_date AS latest_date,
            m.value AS latest_value
           FROM artist_song_metrics_daily m
          ORDER BY m.song_id, m.platform, m.metric, m.metric_date DESC, m.captured_at DESC NULLS LAST
        )
 SELECT l.company_id,
    l.song_id,
    s.title AS song_title,
    l.artist_id,
    l.platform,
    l.metric,
    l.latest_date,
    l.latest_value,
    p1.metric_date AS d1_date,
    p1.value AS v1,
        CASE
            WHEN (p1.value IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (l.latest_value - p1.value)
        END AS delta_1d,
        CASE
            WHEN ((p1.value IS NULL) OR (p1.value = (0)::numeric)) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round((((l.latest_value - p1.value) / p1.value) * (100)::numeric), 2)
        END AS delta_1d_pct,
    p7.metric_date AS d7_date,
    p7.value AS v7,
        CASE
            WHEN (p7.value IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (l.latest_value - p7.value)
        END AS delta_7d,
        CASE
            WHEN ((p7.value IS NULL) OR (p7.value = (0)::numeric)) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round((((l.latest_value - p7.value) / p7.value) * (100)::numeric), 2)
        END AS delta_7d_pct,
    p30.metric_date AS d30_date,
    p30.value AS v30,
        CASE
            WHEN (p30.value IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (l.latest_value - p30.value)
        END AS delta_30d,
        CASE
            WHEN ((p30.value IS NULL) OR (p30.value = (0)::numeric)) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round((((l.latest_value - p30.value) / p30.value) * (100)::numeric), 2)
        END AS delta_30d_pct
   FROM ((((latest l
     JOIN artist_songs s ON ((s.id = l.song_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.metric_date,
            x.value
           FROM artist_song_metrics_daily x
          WHERE ((x.song_id = l.song_id) AND (x.platform = l.platform) AND (x.metric = l.metric) AND ((x.metric_date >= (l.latest_date - 3)) AND (x.metric_date <= (l.latest_date - 1))))
          ORDER BY (abs((x.metric_date - (l.latest_date - 1))))
         LIMIT 1) p1 ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.metric_date,
            x.value
           FROM artist_song_metrics_daily x
          WHERE ((x.song_id = l.song_id) AND (x.platform = l.platform) AND (x.metric = l.metric) AND ((x.metric_date >= (l.latest_date - 12)) AND (x.metric_date <= (l.latest_date - 2))))
          ORDER BY (abs((x.metric_date - (l.latest_date - 7))))
         LIMIT 1) p7 ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.metric_date,
            x.value
           FROM artist_song_metrics_daily x
          WHERE ((x.song_id = l.song_id) AND (x.platform = l.platform) AND (x.metric = l.metric) AND ((x.metric_date >= (l.latest_date - 35)) AND (x.metric_date <= (l.latest_date - 25))))
          ORDER BY (abs((x.metric_date - (l.latest_date - 30))))
         LIMIT 1) p30 ON (true));

views.name: v_song_ugc_benchmark
views.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.song_id, m.platform, m.metric, m.source) m.song_id,
            m.platform,
            m.metric,
            m.source,
            m.metric_date,
            m.value
           FROM artist_song_metrics_daily m
          ORDER BY m.song_id, m.platform, m.metric, m.source, m.metric_date DESC
        )
 SELECT s.id AS song_id,
    s.company_id,
    a.id AS artist_id,
    a.name AS artist_name,
    a.roster_type,
    s.is_reference,
    s.title,
    s.release_date,
        CASE
            WHEN (s.release_date IS NOT NULL) THEN GREATEST((CURRENT_DATE - s.release_date), 0)
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS dias_desde_lancamento,
    COALESCE(tt.value, ttm.value) AS tiktok_videos_latest,
        CASE
            WHEN (tt.value IS NOT NULL) THEN 'aggregator'::text
            WHEN (ttm.value IS NOT NULL) THEN 'manual'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS tiktok_videos_source,
    COALESCE(tt.metric_date, ttm.metric_date) AS tiktok_videos_date,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(tt.value, ttm.value) IS NOT NULL) AND (s.release_date IS NOT NULL) AND ((CURRENT_DATE - s.release_date) > 0)) THEN round((COALESCE(tt.value, ttm.value) / ((CURRENT_DATE - s.release_date))::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS tiktok_videos_por_dia,
    ig.value AS instagram_reels_latest,
    ig.metric_date AS instagram_reels_date,
    sp.value AS spotify_streams_latest,
    sp.metric_date AS spotify_streams_date,
        CASE
            WHEN ((sp.value IS NOT NULL) AND (s.release_date IS NOT NULL) AND ((CURRENT_DATE - s.release_date) > 0)) THEN round((sp.value / ((CURRENT_DATE - s.release_date))::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS spotify_streams_por_dia
   FROM (((((artist_songs s
     JOIN artists a ON ((a.id = s.artist_id)))
     LEFT JOIN latest tt ON (((tt.song_id = s.id) AND (tt.platform = 'tiktok'::text) AND (tt.metric = 'videos'::text) AND (tt.source = 'aggregator'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN latest ttm ON (((ttm.song_id = s.id) AND (ttm.platform = 'tiktok'::text) AND (ttm.metric = 'ugc_videos'::text) AND (ttm.source = 'manual'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN latest ig ON (((ig.song_id = s.id) AND (ig.platform = 'instagram'::text) AND (ig.metric = 'reels'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN latest sp ON (((sp.song_id = s.id) AND (sp.platform = 'spotify'::text) AND (sp.metric = 'streams'::text))))
  WHERE (COALESCE(s.tracking_status, ''::text) <> 'arquivado'::text);

views.name: v_content_latest
views.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT _content_latest_metrics.content_id,
            _content_latest_metrics.metric,
            _content_latest_metrics.metric_date,
            _content_latest_metrics.value
           FROM _content_latest_metrics() _content_latest_metrics(content_id, metric, metric_date, value)
        )
 SELECT c.id AS content_id,
    c.company_id,
    c.artist_id,
    c.platform,
    c.source,
    c.song_id,
    c.song_link_status,
    c.song_link_reason,
    s.title AS song_title,
    COALESCE(c.title, c.caption_excerpt) AS title,
    c.content_type,
    c.published_at,
    c.permalink,
    c.thumbnail_url,
    c.sound_name,
    c.author_handle,
    c.duration_seconds,
    max(l.metric_date) AS last_metric_date,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN (l.metric = 'views'::text) THEN l.value
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS views,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN (l.metric = 'likes'::text) THEN l.value
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS likes,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN (l.metric = 'comments'::text) THEN l.value
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS comments,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN (l.metric = 'shares'::text) THEN l.value
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) AS shares
   FROM ((artist_content c
     LEFT JOIN latest l ON ((l.content_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN artist_songs s ON ((s.id = c.song_id)))
  GROUP BY c.id, s.title;

views.name: v_song_playlist_streams_latest
views.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT artist_song_playlist_streams.song_id,
            artist_song_playlist_streams.period_days,
            max(artist_song_playlist_streams.snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date
           FROM artist_song_playlist_streams
          GROUP BY artist_song_playlist_streams.song_id, artist_song_playlist_streams.period_days
        ), rows AS (
         SELECT p.id,
            p.company_id,
            p.artist_id,
            p.song_id,
            p.snapshot_date,
            p.period_days,
            p.rank,
            p.playlist_name,
            p.made_by,
            p.streams,
            p.date_added,
            p.source,
            p.created_at
           FROM (artist_song_playlist_streams p
             JOIN latest l ON (((l.song_id = p.song_id) AND (l.period_days = p.period_days) AND (l.snapshot_date = p.snapshot_date))))
        ), tot AS (
         SELECT rows.song_id,
            rows.period_days,
            rows.snapshot_date,
            count(*) AS playlists_na_snapshot,
            sum(COALESCE(rows.streams, 0)) AS streams_total,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (rows.made_by = 'spotify'::text) THEN COALESCE(rows.streams, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END) AS streams_spotify_owned,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (rows.made_by = 'user'::text) THEN COALESCE(rows.streams, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END) AS streams_user_playlists
           FROM rows
          GROUP BY rows.song_id, rows.period_days, rows.snapshot_date
        ), top10 AS (
         SELECT x.song_id,
            x.period_days,
            x.snapshot_date,
            sum(COALESCE(x.streams, 0)) AS streams_top10
           FROM ( SELECT rows.song_id,
                    rows.period_days,
                    rows.snapshot_date,
                    rows.streams,
                    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY rows.song_id, rows.period_days ORDER BY COALESCE(rows.streams, 0) DESC) AS rn
                   FROM rows) x
          WHERE (x.rn <= 10)
          GROUP BY x.song_id, x.period_days, x.snapshot_date
        )
 SELECT r.id,
    r.company_id,
    r.artist_id,
    r.song_id,
    r.snapshot_date,
    r.period_days,
    r.rank,
    r.playlist_name,
    r.made_by,
    r.streams,
    r.date_added,
    r.source,
    s.title AS song_title,
    t.playlists_na_snapshot,
    t.streams_total,
    t.streams_spotify_owned,
    t.streams_user_playlists,
    t10.streams_top10,
    sc.subscriber_count AS soundcharts_subscribers,
    sc.playlist_type AS soundcharts_playlist_type,
    sc."position" AS soundcharts_position
   FROM ((((rows r
     JOIN artist_songs s ON ((s.id = r.song_id)))
     JOIN tot t ON (((t.song_id = r.song_id) AND (t.period_days = r.period_days) AND (t.snapshot_date = r.snapshot_date))))
     LEFT JOIN top10 t10 ON (((t10.song_id = r.song_id) AND (t10.period_days = r.period_days) AND (t10.snapshot_date = r.snapshot_date))))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.subscriber_count,
            p.playlist_type,
            p."position"
           FROM artist_song_playlists p
          WHERE ((p.song_id = r.song_id) AND (lower(btrim(p.playlist_name)) = lower(btrim(r.playlist_name))))
          ORDER BY p.exit_date NULLS FIRST, p.last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) sc ON (true));

views.name: v_song_benchmark_aligned
views.definition:
WITH launch AS (
         SELECT s_1.id AS launch_song_id,
            s_1.company_id,
            s_1.artist_id AS launch_artist_id,
            s_1.release_date AS launch_release_date,
            GREATEST((CURRENT_DATE - s_1.release_date), 1) AS n
           FROM artist_songs s_1
          WHERE (s_1.is_launch AND (s_1.release_date IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(s_1.tracking_status, ''::text) <> 'arquivado'::text))
        ), pairs AS (
         SELECT l.launch_song_id,
            l.company_id,
            l.n,
            s2.id AS song_id,
            false AS is_self
           FROM ((launch l
             JOIN artist_comparables ac ON ((ac.artist_id = l.launch_artist_id)))
             JOIN artist_songs s2 ON (((s2.artist_id = ac.comparable_artist_id) AND s2.is_reference AND (s2.release_date IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(s2.tracking_status, ''::text) <> 'arquivado'::text))))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT l.launch_song_id,
            l.company_id,
            l.n,
            l.launch_song_id,
            true
           FROM launch l
        )
 SELECT p.launch_song_id,
    p.company_id,
    p.n AS idade_alinhada_dias,
    p.song_id,
    p.is_self,
    a.id AS artist_id,
    a.name AS artist_name,
    s.title,
    s.release_date,
    (CURRENT_DATE - s.release_date) AS dias_desde_lancamento,
    s.notes AS song_notes,
    spn.value AS spotify_streams_dia_n,
    spn.metric_date AS spotify_streams_dia_n_date,
        CASE
            WHEN (spn.value IS NOT NULL) THEN round((spn.value / (p.n)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS spotify_streams_por_dia_n,
    sph.value AS spotify_streams_hoje,
    sph.metric_date AS spotify_streams_hoje_date,
    tt.value AS tiktok_ugc_latest,
    tt.metric_date AS tiktok_ugc_date,
    tt.source AS tiktok_ugc_source,
        CASE
            WHEN ((tt.value IS NOT NULL) AND (tt.metric_date IS NOT NULL)) THEN round((tt.value / (GREATEST((tt.metric_date - s.release_date), 1))::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS tiktok_ugc_por_dia,
    ig.value AS instagram_reels_latest,
    ig.metric_date AS instagram_reels_date
   FROM ((((((pairs p
     JOIN artist_songs s ON ((s.id = p.song_id)))
     JOIN artists a ON ((a.id = s.artist_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.value,
            m.metric_date
           FROM artist_song_metrics_daily m
          WHERE ((m.song_id = p.song_id) AND (m.platform = 'spotify'::text) AND (m.metric = 'streams'::text) AND (COALESCE(m.source, ''::text) <> 'manual'::text) AND (m.metric_date <= (s.release_date + (p.n - 1))))
          ORDER BY m.metric_date DESC
         LIMIT 1) spn ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.value,
            m.metric_date
           FROM artist_song_metrics_daily m
          WHERE ((m.song_id = p.song_id) AND (m.platform = 'spotify'::text) AND (m.metric = 'streams'::text) AND (COALESCE(m.source, ''::text) <> 'manual'::text))
          ORDER BY m.metric_date DESC
         LIMIT 1) sph ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.value,
            m.metric_date,
            m.source
           FROM artist_song_metrics_daily m
          WHERE ((m.song_id = p.song_id) AND (m.platform = 'tiktok'::text) AND (m.metric = 'ugc_videos'::text) AND (m.source = ANY (ARRAY['ios_shortcut'::text, 'manual'::text])))
          ORDER BY m.metric_date DESC, (m.source = 'ios_shortcut'::text) DESC
         LIMIT 1) tt ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.value,
            m.metric_date
           FROM artist_song_metrics_daily m
          WHERE ((m.song_id = p.song_id) AND (m.platform = 'instagram'::text) AND (m.metric = 'reels'::text))
          ORDER BY m.metric_date DESC
         LIMIT 1) ig ON (true));

views.name: v_artist_chart_gap
views.definition:
WITH lim AS (
         SELECT spotify_chart_daily.country,
            spotify_chart_daily.chart_date,
            max(spotify_chart_daily.streams) FILTER (WHERE (spotify_chart_daily."position" = 100)) AS top100_streams,
            max(spotify_chart_daily.streams) FILTER (WHERE (spotify_chart_daily."position" = 200)) AS top200_streams
           FROM spotify_chart_daily
          GROUP BY spotify_chart_daily.country, spotify_chart_daily.chart_date
        ), m AS (
         SELECT artist_song_metrics_daily.artist_id,
            artist_song_metrics_daily.song_id,
            artist_song_metrics_daily.metric_date,
                CASE artist_song_metrics_daily.metric
                    WHEN 's4a_streams_day_br'::text THEN 'BR'::text
                    ELSE 'PT'::text
                END AS country,
            artist_song_metrics_daily.value
           FROM artist_song_metrics_daily
          WHERE ((artist_song_metrics_daily.platform = 'spotify'::text) AND (artist_song_metrics_daily.metric = ANY (ARRAY['s4a_streams_day_br'::text, 's4a_streams_day_pt'::text])))
        ), pos AS (
         SELECT i.song_id,
            c.country,
            c.chart_date,
            min(c."position") AS best
           FROM (artist_song_identifiers i
             JOIN spotify_chart_daily c ON ((c.spotify_track_id = i.external_id)))
          WHERE (i.platform = 'spotify'::text)
          GROUP BY i.song_id, c.country, c.chart_date
        )
 SELECT m.artist_id,
    m.song_id,
    m.country,
    m.metric_date AS chart_date,
    l.top100_streams,
    l.top200_streams,
    p.best AS artist_best_position,
    m.value AS artist_streams_s4a,
    GREATEST(((l.top200_streams)::numeric - m.value), (0)::numeric) AS gap_top200,
    GREATEST(((l.top100_streams)::numeric - m.value), (0)::numeric) AS gap_top100
   FROM ((m
     JOIN lim l ON (((l.country = m.country) AND (l.chart_date = m.metric_date))))
     LEFT JOIN pos p ON (((p.song_id = m.song_id) AND (p.country = m.country) AND (p.chart_date = m.metric_date))));

views.name: v_artist_release_ranking
views.definition:
WITH med AS (
         SELECT v_artist_release_performance.artist_id,
            v_artist_release_performance.platform,
            v_artist_release_performance.metric,
            percentile_cont((0.5)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((v_artist_release_performance.avg_daily_gain)::double precision)) AS median_avg_daily_gain
           FROM v_artist_release_performance
          WHERE (v_artist_release_performance.avg_daily_gain IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY v_artist_release_performance.artist_id, v_artist_release_performance.platform, v_artist_release_performance.metric
        )
 SELECT p.company_id,
    p.artist_id,
    p.artist_name,
    p.platform,
    p.metric,
    p.release_id,
    p.title,
    p.release_date,
    p.first_value,
    p.latest_value,
    p.total_gain,
    p.days_tracked,
    p.avg_daily_gain,
    p.tracking_started_days_after_release,
    rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p.artist_id, p.platform, p.metric ORDER BY p.avg_daily_gain DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank,
    m.median_avg_daily_gain,
        CASE
            WHEN ((p.avg_daily_gain IS NULL) OR (m.median_avg_daily_gain IS NULL)) THEN NULL::boolean
            ELSE ((p.avg_daily_gain)::double precision >= m.median_avg_daily_gain)
        END AS above_median
   FROM (v_artist_release_performance p
     LEFT JOIN med m ON (((m.artist_id = p.artist_id) AND (m.platform = p.platform) AND (m.metric = p.metric))));

views.name: vw_event_daily_sales
views.definition:
WITH prec AS (
         SELECT daily_sales_mirror_events.event_id,
            daily_sales_mirror_events.provider
           FROM daily_sales_mirror_events() daily_sales_mirror_events(event_id, provider)
        ), mirror AS (
         SELECT d.event_id,
            d.company_id,
            d.sale_date,
            d.quantity,
            d.total_value,
            'ticketline'::text AS source
           FROM ticketline_daily_sales d
        UNION ALL
         SELECT d.event_id,
            d.company_id,
            d.sale_date,
            d.quantity,
            d.total_value,
            'bol'::text AS text
           FROM bol_daily_sales d
        UNION ALL
         SELECT d.event_id,
            d.company_id,
            d.sale_date,
            d.quantity,
            d.total_value,
            'onebox'::text AS text
           FROM onebox_daily_sales d
        )
 SELECT m.event_id,
    m.company_id,
    m.sale_date,
    (sum(m.quantity))::integer AS quantity,
    sum(COALESCE(m.total_value, (0)::numeric)) AS total_value,
    m.source
   FROM mirror m
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM prec p
          WHERE ((p.event_id = m.event_id) AND (p.provider = m.source))))
  GROUP BY m.event_id, m.company_id, m.sale_date, m.source
UNION ALL
 SELECT z.event_id,
    ts.company_id,
    ts.sale_date,
    (sum(ts.quantity))::integer AS quantity,
    sum(COALESCE(ts.total_value, ((COALESCE(ts.quantity, 0))::numeric * COALESCE(ts.unit_price, (0)::numeric)))) AS total_value,
    'ticket_sales'::text AS source
   FROM (ticket_sales ts
     JOIN event_ticket_zones z ON ((z.id = ts.zone_id)))
  WHERE ((z.event_id IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM prec p
          WHERE (p.event_id = z.event_id)))))
  GROUP BY z.event_id, ts.company_id, ts.sale_date;

views.name: v_artist_metric_indexed
views.definition:
WITH win AS (
         SELECT m.company_id,
            m.artist_id,
            m.platform,
            m.metric,
            m.metric_date,
            m.value,
            first_value(m.value) OVER (PARTITION BY m.artist_id, m.platform, m.metric ORDER BY m.metric_date) AS base_value
           FROM artist_metrics_daily m
          WHERE (m.metric_date > (CURRENT_DATE - 365))
        )
 SELECT w.company_id,
    w.artist_id,
    a.name AS artist_name,
    w.platform,
    w.metric,
    w.metric_date,
    w.value,
        CASE
            WHEN ((w.base_value IS NULL) OR (w.base_value = (0)::numeric)) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(((w.value / w.base_value) * (100)::numeric), 2)
        END AS indexed
   FROM (win w
     JOIN artists a ON ((a.id = w.artist_id)));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._test_tickets_v2_invariants()
 RETURNS TABLE(test_name text, passed boolean, detail text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    'tables-exist'::TEXT,
    to_regclass('public.event_ticket_types') IS NOT NULL
      AND to_regclass('public.event_ticket_type_zones') IS NOT NULL
      AND to_regclass('public.tickets_v2_sync_log') IS NOT NULL,
    'Verifica tabelas centrais Tickets V2'::TEXT
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'lots-columns-exist'::TEXT,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'event_ticket_lots' AND column_name = 'ticket_type_id'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'event_ticket_lots' AND column_name = 'sales_window_start'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'event_ticket_lots' AND column_name = 'sales_window_end'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'event_ticket_lots' AND column_name = 'campaign_label'
    ),
    'Verifica colunas Tickets V2 em lotes'::TEXT
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'company-config-columns-exist'::TEXT,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'companies' AND column_name = 'feature_tickets_v2'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'companies' AND column_name = 'tickets_config'
    ),
    'Verifica flags/config Tickets V2 em empresas'::TEXT;

  SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.artist_metric_growth(_artist_id uuid, _days integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(company_id uuid, platform text, metric text, base_date date, base_value numeric, latest_date date, latest_value numeric, delta numeric, delta_pct numeric, days_span integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.platform, m.metric)
      m.company_id, m.platform, m.metric, m.metric_date, m.value
    FROM public.artist_metrics_daily m
    WHERE m.artist_id = _artist_id
    ORDER BY m.platform, m.metric, m.metric_date DESC,
      CASE m.source WHEN 'aggregator' THEN 1 WHEN 'platform_api' THEN 2 WHEN 'public_page' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
  )
  SELECT
    l.company_id,
    l.platform,
    l.metric,
    b.metric_date,
    b.value,
    l.metric_date,
    l.value,
    CASE WHEN b.value IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE l.value - b.value END,
    -- delta_pct: NULL se não houver base ou se base = 0 (divisão impossível)
    CASE WHEN b.value IS NULL OR b.value = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE round((l.value - b.value) / b.value * 100, 2) END,
    CASE WHEN b.metric_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (l.metric_date - b.metric_date) END
  FROM latest l
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p.metric_date, p.value
    FROM public.artist_metrics_daily p
    WHERE p.artist_id = _artist_id
      AND p.platform = l.platform
      AND p.metric = l.metric
      AND p.metric_date BETWEEN (l.metric_date - _days - 5) AND (l.metric_date - _days + 5)
    ORDER BY abs(p.metric_date - (l.metric_date - _days)),
      CASE p.source WHEN 'aggregator' THEN 1 WHEN 'platform_api' THEN 2 WHEN 'public_page' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) b ON true;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.artist_metric_indexed_common(_artist_ids uuid[], _platform text, _metric text, _start_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, _end_date date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS TABLE(company_id uuid, artist_id uuid, artist_name text, platform text, metric text, metric_date date, value numeric, base_date date, base_value numeric, indexed numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH win AS (
    SELECT m.company_id, m.artist_id, m.platform, m.metric, m.metric_date, m.value
      FROM public.artist_metrics_daily m
     WHERE m.artist_id = ANY(_artist_ids)
       AND m.platform = _platform
       AND m.metric = _metric
       AND (_start_date IS NULL OR m.metric_date >= _start_date)
       AND (_end_date   IS NULL OR m.metric_date <= _end_date)
  ),
  common AS (
    SELECT w.metric_date
      FROM win w
     GROUP BY w.metric_date
    HAVING count(DISTINCT w.artist_id) = (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.artist_id) FROM win x)
     ORDER BY w.metric_date
     LIMIT 1
  ),
  bases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.artist_id) w.artist_id, w.metric_date AS base_date, w.value AS base_value
      FROM win w
      JOIN common c ON c.metric_date = w.metric_date
     ORDER BY w.artist_id, w.metric_date
  )
  SELECT w.company_id, w.artist_id, a.name, w.platform, w.metric, w.metric_date, w.value,
         b.base_date, b.base_value,
         CASE WHEN b.base_value IS NULL OR b.base_value = 0 THEN NULL
              ELSE round(w.value / b.base_value * 100, 2) END
    FROM win w
    JOIN public.artists a ON a.id = w.artist_id
    LEFT JOIN bases b ON b.artist_id = w.artist_id
   ORDER BY w.artist_id, w.metric_date;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_operacao_etapa(_etapa_id uuid, _user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    public.is_platform_admin(_user_id)
    OR public.has_permission(_user_id, 'manage_operacao_etapas')
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.operacao_etapas e
      JOIN public.operacao_frentes f ON f.id = e.frente_id
      WHERE e.id = _etapa_id AND f.current_lead_id = _user_id
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.operacao_etapas e
      JOIN public.operacao_frentes z ON z.id = e.zone_id
      WHERE e.id = _etapa_id AND z.type = 'zone' AND z.current_lead_id = _user_id
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.operacao_etapas e
      JOIN public.operacao_frentes f ON f.id = e.frente_id
      JOIN public.event_team_members m ON m.event_id = f.event_id
      WHERE e.id = _etapa_id
        AND m.profile_id = _user_id
        AND m.role = 'general_producer'
        AND (
          m.scope = 'full'
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.event_team_member_zones mz
            WHERE mz.member_id = m.id
              AND mz.zone_id IN (e.zone_id, e.frente_id)
          )
        )
    );

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_tx_paid_requires_account()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status = 'paid' AND NEW.account_id IS NULL THEN
    -- Isenções documentadas:
    --  * fluxos server-side (edge functions / importações) correm como service_role
    --  * transitórias (caução, irmã "extra do sócio"), fora do resultado e reembolsos
    --    nascem legitimamente sem conta da empresa
    --  * (g7) compensação: encontro de contas NUNCA tem conta por desenho
    --    (trigger force_no_account_on_compensation limpa account_id), e uma receita
    --    com "Recebido por" nasce paga (trg_enforce_held_revenue_is_paid)
    IF current_user IN ('service_role', 'postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'supabase_storage_admin')
       OR COALESCE(NEW.is_transitory, false)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.exclude_from_result, false)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.is_reimbursement, false)
       OR COALESCE(NEW.payment_method, '') = 'compensation' THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transação paga exige conta financeira associada (account_id).';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fx_convert(p_amount numeric, p_from text, p_to text, p_date date)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_amount IS NULL OR p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL OR p_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN upper(p_from) = upper(p_to) THEN p_amount
    ELSE p_amount * rf.r / nullif(rt.r, 0)
  END
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN upper(coalesce(p_from,'')) = 'EUR' THEN 1::numeric ELSE
      (SELECT f.rate_to_eur FROM public.fx_rates_daily f
        WHERE f.currency = upper(p_from) AND f.rate_date = p_date) END AS r
  ) rf,
  (
    SELECT CASE WHEN upper(coalesce(p_to,'')) = 'EUR' THEN 1::numeric ELSE
      (SELECT f.rate_to_eur FROM public.fx_rates_daily f
        WHERE f.currency = upper(p_to) AND f.rate_date = p_date) END AS r
  ) rt
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_daily_sales_series(p_start date, p_end date, p_event_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], p_provider text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(group_id uuid, event_id uuid, event_name text, event_date date, sale_date date, provider text, qty bigint, value numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.name, e.date, COALESCE(e.parent_event_id, e.id) AS gid
  FROM public.events e WHERE COALESCE(e.management_type, 'own') = 'own'
),
grp AS (
  SELECT ev.gid, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ev.id = ev.gid THEN ev.name END), MIN(ev.name)) AS gname, MIN(ev.date) AS gdate
  FROM ev GROUP BY ev.gid
),
scoped AS (
  SELECT ev.id, ev.gid FROM ev
  WHERE p_event_ids IS NULL OR ev.gid = ANY(p_event_ids) OR ev.id = ANY(p_event_ids)
),
prec AS (SELECT * FROM public.daily_sales_mirror_events()),
ts_rows AS (
  SELECT s.gid, s.id AS eid, ts.sale_date,
         CASE WHEN ts.source = 'ticketline_import' THEN 'Ticketline'
              WHEN ts.source = 'bol' THEN 'BOL'
              WHEN ts.source = 'fever_import' THEN 'Fever'
              WHEN ts.source = 'onebox_import' THEN 'Onebox'
              ELSE 'Outras' END AS provider,
         SUM(ts.quantity)::bigint AS qty,
         SUM(COALESCE(ts.total_value, ts.quantity * ts.unit_price, 0))::numeric AS value
  FROM public.ticket_sales ts
  JOIN public.event_ticket_zones z ON z.id = ts.zone_id
  JOIN scoped s ON s.id = z.event_id
  WHERE ts.sale_date BETWEEN p_start AND p_end
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prec p WHERE p.event_id = z.event_id)
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
),
bol_rows AS (
  SELECT s.gid, s.id AS eid, d.sale_date, 'BOL'::text AS provider,
         SUM(d.quantity)::bigint, SUM(COALESCE(d.total_value, 0))::numeric
  FROM public.bol_daily_sales d JOIN scoped s ON s.id = d.event_id
  WHERE d.sale_date BETWEEN p_start AND p_end
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prec p WHERE p.event_id = d.event_id AND p.provider = 'bol')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
),
tl_rows AS (
  SELECT s.gid, s.id AS eid, d.sale_date, 'Ticketline'::text AS provider,
         SUM(d.quantity)::bigint, SUM(COALESCE(d.total_value, 0))::numeric
  FROM public.ticketline_daily_sales d JOIN scoped s ON s.id = d.event_id
  WHERE d.sale_date BETWEEN p_start AND p_end
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prec p WHERE p.event_id = d.event_id AND p.provider = 'ticketline')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
),
ob_rows AS (
  SELECT s.gid, s.id AS eid, d.sale_date, 'Onebox'::text AS provider,
         SUM(d.quantity)::bigint, SUM(COALESCE(d.total_value, 0))::numeric
  FROM public.onebox_daily_sales d JOIN scoped s ON s.id = d.event_id
  WHERE d.sale_date BETWEEN p_start AND p_end
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prec p WHERE p.event_id = d.event_id AND p.provider = 'onebox')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
),
allr AS (
  SELECT * FROM ts_rows UNION ALL SELECT * FROM bol_rows UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tl_rows UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ob_rows
)
SELECT a.gid, a.eid, g.gname, g.gdate, a.sale_date, a.provider, SUM(a.qty)::bigint, SUM(a.value)::numeric
FROM allr a JOIN grp g ON g.gid = a.gid
WHERE p_provider IS NULL OR a.provider = p_provider
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
HAVING SUM(a.qty) <> 0 OR SUM(a.value) <> 0
ORDER BY 3, 5, 6;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_event_bp_changes(p_event_id uuid, p_days integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(changed_at timestamp with time zone, action text, author text, forecast_id uuid, description text, forecast_type text, changes jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT l.created_at, l.action, l.changed_by, l.entity_id, l.old_data, l.new_data
  FROM public.system_audit_log l
  WHERE l.entity_type = 'event_forecasts'
    AND coalesce(l.new_data->>'event_id', l.old_data->>'event_id') = p_event_id::text
    AND l.created_at >= now() - ((coalesce(p_days, 30))::text || ' days')::interval
),
fields(ord, field, label) AS (
  VALUES
    (1,  'description',         'Descrição'),
    (2,  'amount',              'Valor'),
    (3,  'type',                'Tipo'),
    (4,  'status',              'Estado'),
    (5,  'category_id',         'Categoria'),
    (6,  'specification',       'Especificação'),
    (7,  'iva_rate',            'Taxa IVA'),
    (8,  'notes',               'Notas'),
    (9,  'exclude_from_result', 'Excluir do resultado'),
    (10, 'is_transitory',       'Transitória'),
    (11, 'formalidade',         'Formalidade'),
    (12, 'transaction_id',      'Transação vinculada')
),
diffed AS (
  SELECT
    r.created_at,
    r.action,
    r.changed_by,
    coalesce((r.new_data->>'id'), (r.old_data->>'id'), r.entity_id::text)::uuid AS forecast_id,
    coalesce(r.new_data->>'description', r.old_data->>'description') AS description,
    coalesce(r.new_data->>'type', r.old_data->>'type') AS forecast_type,
    coalesce((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(x.item ORDER BY x.ord)
      FROM (
        SELECT
          f.ord,
          jsonb_build_object(
            'field',  f.field,
            'label',  f.label,
            'before', CASE WHEN f.field = 'category_id'
                        THEN (SELECT c.code || ' — ' || c.name FROM public.account_categories c
                               WHERE c.id::text = r.old_data->>'category_id')
                        ELSE r.old_data->>f.field END,
            'after',  CASE WHEN f.field = 'category_id'
                        THEN (SELECT c.code || ' — ' || c.name FROM public.account_categories c
                               WHERE c.id::text = r.new_data->>'category_id')
                        ELSE r.new_data->>f.field END
          ) AS item
        FROM fields f
        WHERE (r.old_data->>f.field) IS DISTINCT FROM (r.new_data->>f.field)
      ) x
    ), '[]'::jsonb) AS changes
  FROM raw r
)
SELECT
  d.created_at AS changed_at,
  d.action,
  coalesce(p.full_name, 'Sistema') AS author,
  d.forecast_id,
  d.description,
  d.forecast_type,
  d.changes
FROM diffed d
LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id::text = d.changed_by
WHERE d.action <> 'update' OR jsonb_array_length(d.changes) > 0
ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_event_capacity_quality()
 RETURNS TABLE(group_id uuid, capacity bigint, available bigint, occupied bigint, blocked bigint, zones integer, zones_oversold integer, last_observed date, stale boolean, trustworthy boolean, issue text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date AS today
),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.id, COALESCE(e.parent_event_id, e.id) AS gid
  FROM public.events e
  WHERE COALESCE(e.management_type, 'own') = 'own'
),
latest_obs AS (
  SELECT c.event_id, MAX(c.observed_on) AS max_on
  FROM public.event_zone_capacities c
  WHERE c.capacity_kind = 'released'
  GROUP BY c.event_id
),
latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.event_id, c.zone_label)
         c.event_id, c.zone_label, c.capacity, c.available, c.occupied, c.blocked, c.observed_on
  FROM public.event_zone_capacities c
  JOIN latest_obs m ON m.event_id = c.event_id AND m.max_on = c.observed_on
  WHERE c.capacity_kind = 'released'
  ORDER BY c.event_id, c.zone_label, c.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
),
agg AS (
  SELECT ev.gid,
         COALESCE(SUM(l.capacity), 0)::bigint  AS capacity,
         COALESCE(SUM(l.available), 0)::bigint AS available,
         COALESCE(SUM(l.occupied), 0)::bigint  AS occupied,
         COALESCE(SUM(l.blocked), 0)::bigint   AS blocked,
         COUNT(l.zone_label)::int              AS zones,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.occupied IS NOT NULL AND l.capacity IS NOT NULL AND l.occupied > l.capacity)::int AS zones_oversold,
         MAX(l.observed_on)                    AS last_observed
  FROM ev
  JOIN latest l ON l.event_id = ev.id
  GROUP BY ev.gid
),
f AS (
  SELECT a.*, (a.last_observed IS NULL OR a.last_observed < r.today - 2) AS stale
  FROM agg a CROSS JOIN ref r
)
SELECT f.gid AS group_id,
       f.capacity,
       f.available,
       f.occupied,
       f.blocked,
       f.zones,
       f.zones_oversold,
       f.last_observed,
       f.stale,
       (f.zones > 0 AND f.capacity > 0 AND NOT f.stale) AS trustworthy,
       CASE
         WHEN (f.zones > 0 AND f.capacity > 0 AND NOT f.stale) THEN NULL
         WHEN f.zones = 0 THEN 'sem observação de lotação da bilheteira'
         WHEN f.stale THEN 'última observação de ' || to_char(f.last_observed, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
         WHEN f.capacity = 0 THEN 'lotação a zero na última observação'
         ELSE 'sem observação de lotação da bilheteira'
       END AS issue
FROM f;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_sales_position()
 RETURNS TABLE(group_id uuid, event_name text, event_date date, child_count integer, total_qty bigint, total_value numeric, last7_qty bigint, last7_value numeric, yesterday_qty bigint, yesterday_value numeric, today_qty bigint, today_value numeric, has_bol boolean, daily_missing boolean, fortnight_qty bigint, fortnight_value numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT d AS today,
         CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM d) <= 15
              THEN date_trunc('month', d)::date
              ELSE date_trunc('month', d)::date + 15
         END AS fstart,
         CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM d) <= 15
              THEN date_trunc('month', d)::date + 14
              ELSE (date_trunc('month', d)::date + INTERVAL '1 month')::date - 1
         END AS fend
  FROM (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date AS d) x
),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.name, e.date, e.status, e.parent_event_id,
         COALESCE(e.parent_event_id, e.id) AS gid
  FROM public.events e
  WHERE COALESCE(e.management_type, 'own') = 'own'
),
sales AS (
  SELECT z.event_id,
         SUM(ts.quantity)::bigint AS qty,
         SUM(ts.total_value)::numeric AS val,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN ts.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS q7,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN ts.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qf,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN ts.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS v7,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN ts.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vf,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN ts.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qy,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN ts.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vy,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date = r.today THEN ts.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qt,
         SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date = r.today THEN ts.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vt,
         MAX(ts.sale_date) AS last_sale
  FROM public.ticket_sales ts
  JOIN public.event_ticket_zones z ON z.id = ts.zone_id
  CROSS JOIN ref r
  GROUP BY z.event_id
),
bol AS (
  SELECT c.event_id, bool_or(COALESCE(c.enabled, false)) AS active
  FROM public.bol_sync_config c
  GROUP BY c.event_id
),
daily AS (
  SELECT d.event_id,
         COUNT(*)::bigint AS n,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS q7,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qf,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS v7,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vf,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qy,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vy,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qt,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vt
  FROM public.bol_daily_sales d
  CROSS JOIN ref r
  GROUP BY d.event_id
),
ob AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.event_id FROM public.onebox_daily_sales d
),
obw AS (
  SELECT d.event_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS q7,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qf,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS v7,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vf,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qy,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vy,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qt,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vt
  FROM public.onebox_daily_sales d
  CROSS JOIN ref r
  GROUP BY d.event_id
),
tlfb AS (
  SELECT c.event_id
  FROM public.ticketline_sync_config c
  GROUP BY c.event_id
  HAVING bool_or(COALESCE(c.daily_fallback_active, false))
),
tld AS (
  SELECT d.event_id,
         COUNT(*)::bigint AS n,
         SUM(d.quantity)::bigint AS qty,
         SUM(d.total_value)::numeric AS val,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS q7,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qf,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS v7,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vf,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qy,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vy,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS qt,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS vt
  FROM public.ticketline_daily_sales d
  CROSS JOIN ref r
  GROUP BY d.event_id
),
per AS (
  SELECT ev.gid, ev.id, ev.name, ev.date, ev.status, ev.parent_event_id,
         (t.event_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_tlfb,
         CASE WHEN t.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(td.qty, 0) ELSE COALESCE(s.qty, 0) END AS tq,
         CASE WHEN t.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(td.val, 0) ELSE COALESCE(s.val, 0) END AS tv,
         COALESCE(b.active, false) AS is_bol,
         (d.n IS NOT NULL) AS has_daily,
         s.last_sale,
         CASE WHEN t.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(td.q7, 0)
              WHEN o.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ow.q7, 0)
              WHEN COALESCE(b.active, false) THEN COALESCE(d.q7, 0) ELSE COALESCE(s.q7, 0) END AS w7q,
         CASE WHEN t.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(td.v7, 0)
              WHEN o.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ow.v7, 0)
              WHEN COALESCE(b.active, false) THEN COALESCE(d.v7, 0) ELSE COALESCE(s.v7, 0) END AS w7v,
         CASE WHEN t.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(td.qf, 0)
              WHEN o.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ow.qf, 0)
              WHEN COALESCE(b.active, false) THEN COALESCE(d.qf, 0) ELSE COALESCE(s.qf, 0) END AS wfq,
         CASE WHEN t.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(td.vf, 0)
              WHEN o.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ow.vf, 0)
              WHEN COALESCE(b.active, false) THEN COALESCE(d.vf, 0) ELSE COALESCE(s.vf, 0) END AS wfv,
         CASE WHEN t.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(td.qy, 0)
              WHEN o.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ow.qy, 0)
              WHEN COALESCE(b.active, false) THEN COALESCE(d.qy, 0) ELSE COALESCE(s.qy, 0) END AS wyq,
         CASE WHEN t.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(td.vy, 0)
              WHEN o.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ow.vy, 0)
              WHEN COALESCE(b.active, false) THEN COALESCE(d.vy, 0) ELSE COALESCE(s.vy, 0) END AS wyv,
         CASE WHEN t.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(td.qt, 0)
              WHEN o.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ow.qt, 0)
              WHEN COALESCE(b.active, false) THEN COALESCE(d.qt, 0) ELSE COALESCE(s.qt, 0) END AS wtq,
         CASE WHEN t.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(td.vt, 0)
              WHEN o.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ow.vt, 0)
              WHEN COALESCE(b.active, false) THEN COALESCE(d.vt, 0) ELSE COALESCE(s.vt, 0) END AS wtv
  FROM ev
  LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.event_id = ev.id
  LEFT JOIN bol b ON b.event_id = ev.id
  LEFT JOIN daily d ON d.event_id = ev.id
  LEFT JOIN tlfb t ON t.event_id = ev.id
  LEFT JOIN tld td ON td.event_id = ev.id
  LEFT JOIN ob o ON o.event_id = ev.id
  LEFT JOIN obw ow ON ow.event_id = ev.id
),
keep AS (
  SELECT per.gid, MIN(per.date) AS next_date
  FROM per
  CROSS JOIN ref r
  WHERE per.date >= r.today
    AND COALESCE(per.status, '') NOT IN ('cancelled', 'completed', 'archived')
  GROUP BY per.gid
)
SELECT p.gid AS group_id,
       COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN p.id = p.gid THEN p.name END), MIN(p.name)) AS event_name,
       MIN(k.next_date) AS event_date,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.parent_event_id IS NOT NULL)::integer AS child_count,
       SUM(p.tq)::bigint AS total_qty,
       SUM(p.tv)::numeric AS total_value,
       SUM(p.w7q)::bigint AS last7_qty,
       SUM(p.w7v)::numeric AS last7_value,
       SUM(p.wyq)::bigint AS yesterday_qty,
       SUM(p.wyv)::numeric AS yesterday_value,
       SUM(p.wtq)::bigint AS today_qty,
       SUM(p.wtv)::numeric AS today_value,
       bool_or(p.is_bol) AS has_bol,
       bool_or(p.is_bol AND NOT p.has_daily) AS daily_missing,
       SUM(p.wfq)::bigint AS fortnight_qty,
       SUM(p.wfv)::numeric AS fortnight_value
FROM per p
JOIN keep k ON k.gid = p.gid
GROUP BY p.gid
ORDER BY 3 ASC NULLS LAST;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_sales_position_by_provider()
 RETURNS TABLE(provider text, sort_order integer, total_qty bigint, total_value numeric, last7_qty bigint, last7_value numeric, yesterday_qty bigint, yesterday_value numeric, today_qty bigint, today_value numeric, fortnight_qty bigint, fortnight_value numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT d AS today,
         CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM d) <= 15
              THEN date_trunc('month', d)::date
              ELSE date_trunc('month', d)::date + 15
         END AS fstart,
         CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM d) <= 15
              THEN date_trunc('month', d)::date + 14
              ELSE (date_trunc('month', d)::date + INTERVAL '1 month')::date - 1
         END AS fend
  FROM (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date AS d) x
),
ev AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.date, e.status, COALESCE(e.parent_event_id, e.id) AS gid
  FROM public.events e
  WHERE COALESCE(e.management_type, 'own') = 'own'
),
keep AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ev.gid FROM ev
  CROSS JOIN ref r
  WHERE ev.date >= r.today
    AND COALESCE(ev.status, '') NOT IN ('cancelled', 'completed', 'archived')
),
scoped AS (
  SELECT ev.id FROM ev JOIN keep k ON k.gid = ev.gid
),
tlfb AS (
  SELECT c.event_id
  FROM public.ticketline_sync_config c
  GROUP BY c.event_id
  HAVING bool_or(COALESCE(c.daily_fallback_active, false))
),
ts AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN ts.source = 'ticketline_import' THEN 'Ticketline'
           WHEN ts.source = 'bol' THEN 'BOL'
           WHEN ts.source = 'fever_import' THEN 'Fever'
           WHEN ts.source = 'onebox_import' THEN 'Onebox'
           ELSE 'Outras'
         END AS provider,
         COALESCE(SUM(ts.quantity),0)::bigint AS tq,
         COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(ts.total_value, ts.quantity * ts.unit_price, 0)),0)::numeric AS tv,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN ts.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS q7,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN ts.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qf,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN COALESCE(ts.total_value, ts.quantity * ts.unit_price, 0) ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS v7,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN COALESCE(ts.total_value, ts.quantity * ts.unit_price, 0) ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vf,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN ts.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qy,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN COALESCE(ts.total_value, ts.quantity * ts.unit_price, 0) ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vy,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date = r.today THEN ts.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qt,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts.sale_date = r.today THEN COALESCE(ts.total_value, ts.quantity * ts.unit_price, 0) ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vt
  FROM public.ticket_sales ts
  JOIN public.event_ticket_zones z ON z.id = ts.zone_id
  JOIN scoped s ON s.id = z.event_id
  CROSS JOIN ref r
  WHERE z.event_id NOT IN (SELECT event_id FROM tlfb)
  GROUP BY 1
),
tld AS (
  SELECT 'Ticketline'::text AS provider,
         COALESCE(SUM(d.quantity),0)::bigint AS tq,
         COALESCE(SUM(d.total_value),0)::numeric AS tv,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS q7,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qf,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS v7,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vf,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qy,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vy,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qt,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vt
  FROM public.ticketline_daily_sales d
  JOIN scoped s ON s.id = d.event_id
  JOIN tlfb t ON t.event_id = d.event_id
  CROSS JOIN ref r
),
unioned AS (
  SELECT provider, tq, tv, q7, v7, qf, vf, qy, vy, qt, vt FROM ts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT provider, tq, tv, q7, v7, qf, vf, qy, vy, qt, vt FROM tld
),
agg AS (
  SELECT provider,
         SUM(tq)::bigint AS tq, SUM(tv)::numeric AS tv,
         SUM(q7)::bigint AS q7, SUM(v7)::numeric AS v7,
         SUM(qf)::bigint AS qf, SUM(vf)::numeric AS vf,
         SUM(qy)::bigint AS qy, SUM(vy)::numeric AS vy,
         SUM(qt)::bigint AS qt, SUM(vt)::numeric AS vt
  FROM unioned
  GROUP BY 1
),
bolw AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS q7,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qf,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS v7,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vf,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qy,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vy,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qt,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vt
  FROM public.bol_daily_sales d
  JOIN scoped s ON s.id = d.event_id
  CROSS JOIN ref r
),
obw AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS q7,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qf,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.today - 7 AND r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS v7,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date BETWEEN r.fstart AND r.fend THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vf,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qy,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today - 1 THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vy,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)::bigint AS qt,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.sale_date = r.today THEN d.total_value ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric AS vt
  FROM public.onebox_daily_sales d
  JOIN scoped s ON s.id = d.event_id
  CROSS JOIN ref r
)
SELECT a.provider,
       CASE a.provider WHEN 'Ticketline' THEN 1 WHEN 'BOL' THEN 2 WHEN 'Fever' THEN 3 WHEN 'Onebox' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END AS sort_order,
       a.tq AS total_qty,
       a.tv AS total_value,
       CASE WHEN a.provider = 'BOL' THEN COALESCE((SELECT q7 FROM bolw), 0) WHEN a.provider = 'Onebox' THEN COALESCE((SELECT q7 FROM obw), 0) ELSE a.q7 END AS last7_qty,
       CASE WHEN a.provider = 'BOL' THEN COALESCE((SELECT v7 FROM bolw), 0) WHEN a.provider = 'Onebox' THEN COALESCE((SELECT v7 FROM obw), 0) ELSE a.v7 END AS last7_value,
       CASE WHEN a.provider = 'BOL' THEN COALESCE((SELECT qy FROM bolw), 0) WHEN a.provider = 'Onebox' THEN COALESCE((SELECT qy FROM obw), 0) ELSE a.qy END AS yesterday_qty,
       CASE WHEN a.provider = 'BOL' THEN COALESCE((SELECT vy FROM bolw), 0) WHEN a.provider = 'Onebox' THEN COALESCE((SELECT vy FROM obw), 0) ELSE a.vy END AS yesterday_value,
       CASE WHEN a.provider = 'BOL' THEN COALESCE((SELECT qt FROM bolw), 0) WHEN a.provider = 'Onebox' THEN COALESCE((SELECT qt FROM obw), 0) ELSE a.qt END AS today_qty,
       CASE WHEN a.provider = 'BOL' THEN COALESCE((SELECT vt FROM bolw), 0) WHEN a.provider = 'Onebox' THEN COALESCE((SELECT vt FROM obw), 0) ELSE a.vt END AS today_value,
       CASE WHEN a.provider = 'BOL' THEN COALESCE((SELECT qf FROM bolw), 0) WHEN a.provider = 'Onebox' THEN COALESCE((SELECT qf FROM obw), 0) ELSE a.qf END AS fortnight_qty,
       CASE WHEN a.provider = 'BOL' THEN COALESCE((SELECT vf FROM bolw), 0) WHEN a.provider = 'Onebox' THEN COALESCE((SELECT vf FROM obw), 0) ELSE a.vf END AS fortnight_value
FROM agg a
WHERE COALESCE(a.tq, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(a.tv, 0) <> 0
ORDER BY 2, 1;
$function$
